meta.description: Daily curated Claude AI skills news for small and medium businesses

entries.title: Anthropic Ships 31 Built-in Small Business Skills for Claude Cowork — Tax, CRM, Payroll & More
entries.summary: Anthropic officially shipped a bundled plugin of 31 small business skills for Claude Cowork — covering money/tax (10 skills), sales/CRM (6), marketing (3), customers (4), briefings (3), and hiring/legal (5). Install via Cowork's plugin store, connect QuickBooks/PayPal/HubSpot, then run /smb-onboard to get started. SMB owners: this is the lowest-friction way to add tax prep, cash-flow forecasting, invoicing, contract review, and lead triage without writing any code.

entries.title: Exodata Publishes Hands-On Claude Fable 5 Workflow Playbook for SMBs
entries.summary: A step-by-step playbook walks SMB owners through setting up Claude Fable 5 for real business workflows — financial auditing, spreadsheet migration, internal tool building, and competitive research. Covers connecting data sources, writing effective prompts for each use case, and deploying with Google Apps Script. Actionable for any owner looking to put the free Fable 5 window (through June 22) to work.

entries.title: Claude for SMBs Webinar: Live Training on Claude's Small Business Capabilities
entries.summary: A dedicated webinar teaches SMB owners how to leverage Claude's small business capabilities — from basic prompting to setting up automated workflows. Covers model selection for different business tasks, connecting data sources, and building repeatable processes. Free registration available for business owners who want structured guidance.

entries.title: 10 Things SMBs Can Finally Do with Claude Fable 5 — From CFO Audits to Contract Negotiation
entries.summary: A practical breakdown of 10 Fable 5 use cases tailored to SMBs: audit finances like a CFO, migrate spreadsheets to real databases, build internal tools without developers, run overnight research projects, structure receipts/PDFs into spreadsheets, replace strategy consultants, build support agents from SOPs, negotiate contracts, automate manual workflows, and strategically use the free Pro/Max window. Each item includes specific prompts and expected outcomes.

entries.title: Claude Cowork Plugin Gets 12 Data Connectors at Launch — QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot Included
entries.summary: The new 31-skill Small Business plugin for Claude Cowork ships with 12 data connectors at launch (QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, and others). The /smb-onboard command walks through your first two connectors and runs a business interview so every other skill gets context. SMB owners: connect your existing tools in minutes and start getting AI-powered tax prep, cash-flow snapshots, lead scoring, and contract reviews automatically.

entries.title: YouTube: Claude Fable 5 for Business Operations — What SMB Owners Need to Know
entries.summary: A video walkthrough explains what Fable 5 means specifically for small business owners — from the free Pro/Max window through June 22 to which workflows deliver the most ROI. Covers tax prep, invoicing, lead management, and contract review as the highest-impact starting points for non-technical SMB owners.
